links.outcome: Gap between LLM knowledge accuracy and clinical ethical reasoning performance
links.effect: Models showed significant ethical reasoning gaps despite high knowledge accuracy; no numeric results in the provided text.
links.quote: Evaluating recent models reveals significant ethical reasoning gaps despite high knowledge accuracy, demonstrating that knowledge-oriented training does not ensure clinical ethical alignment.

unlisted_practices: Assessing LLM clinical medical ethics alignment with an expert-validated benchmark grounded in Principlism

screen.reason: The study introduces and applies PrinciplismQA, an automated benchmark designed to evaluate clinical medical ethics alignment in LLMs, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
